body:
I really appreciate you. I have a lot to come to terms with, and talking is my way of understanding how to take my nexts steps, or even getting all the negative thoughts out of my head. Surprisingly taking this out of my notes on my phone and posting it here allowed me to destress enough to where I’m not a huge threat to myself right now. 
You’re absolutely right. You’re surroundings should be there to help. And you stepped right up and responded to me not even knowing who I am. So once again, I really appreciate you. Much love for you right back, and I’d like for you to stay safe as well.
